source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Create one independently randomized, complex photographic test scene for this allocated arm, using the attached portrait only for narrowly scoped visible adult appearance while making the assigned upright bass meaning unmistakable in the rendered pixels.
subject: An original adult double-bass performer shown together with the complete floor-supported instrument.
setting: A decommissioned coastal pump hall with wet concrete, tall steel windows, and a partly open rolling service door at blue hour.
event: The standing performer sustains an active bowed phrase as sea mist enters through the service door.
visual_priorities: Readable human-to-instrument scale and uninterrupted view from scroll to floor-contacting endpin
Anatomically plausible simultaneous left-hand fingering and right-hand bow contact
Scoped continuity with Image 1 limited to visible adult face, hair, makeup, and skin-surface finish
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic vertical environmental portrait in a decommissioned coastal pump hall at blue hour. An original adult double-bass performer stands on wet concrete during a sustained bowed phrase. A full-sized upright double bass rises nearly to the standing performer's head; its elongated neck and scroll extend above the left shoulder, while its metal endpin visibly bears on the floor. The left hand presses the strings along the long fingerboard and the right hand draws a bow in clear contact across the strings. A partly open rolling service door admits a ribbon of sea mist. Cyan window light crosses one warm tungsten maintenance lamp, tracing the instrument's varnished wood and its complete silhouette. Use a low eye-level 35mm full-body composition that keeps the performer, scroll, broad lower bouts, hands, bow contact, endpin, and floor junction simultaneously legible. Use Image 1 solely as reference for visible adult facial appearance, long dark wavy hair, understated eye makeup, and softly luminous skin-surface finish, realized as a distinct original adult performer.
